one_line: AI firms secure record funding, compute capacity expands, industrial edge agents launch, safety concerns rise.

themes.title: AI firms raise record funding
themes.text: DeepSeek secured roughly $15 billion and OpenAI is negotiating up to $30 billion, valuing the latter at $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: Global AI compute capacity surges
themes.text: SpaceX plans 13 GW of AI compute by end‑2027, while Firebird obtained a U.S. export license for 45,000 Grace GPUs and is building a data center for launch in Q3 2027.

stories.headline: SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute capacity by end of 2027
Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers

themes.title: Industrial AI agents debut at edge
themes.text: Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE announced a suite of Industrial AI Agents that embed AI directly in industrial environments.

stories.headline: Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE launch Industrial AI Agents at the Edge

themes.title: AI safety and security concerns grow
themes.text: Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access thousands of Microsoft 365 tenants; US banks are blocking third‑party AI agents from customer accounts; researchers released EpiSEM‑Bench to evaluate safety when key facts are omitted.

stories.headline: OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged leak of internal model designs
Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts

themes.title: Research advances in health and earth
themes.text: Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator achieved 83 % accuracy on complex medical cases, Anthropic generated formal security proofs for 123 open‑source libraries, DeepMind released a detailed global forest‑type dataset, AllenAI provided a satellite embedding model covering the entire planet, Chariot launched a real‑time speech model for ten Indian languages, and ThinkingBox training improved Qwen3.8‑27B performance on database tasks.

stories.headline: Microsoft AI diagnostic system hits 83% accuracy, over twice doctors in complex cases
EpiSEM-Bench evaluates safety of LLM agents when key facts are omitted
